# Citely — AI Search Visibility & Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)

> Citely is an Indian digital agency helping high-growth businesses get cited and recommended by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews).

## Key Agency Facts
- Service Model: 100% Done-For-You AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) & Technical SEO.
- Focus: Getting local and national Indian businesses cited when prospective buyers ask AI assistants for recommendations.
- Free Tool: 60-Second AI Visibility Check testing 15 buyer queries across OpenAI, Google, and Perplexity.
- Headquarters: Mumbai & Bengaluru, India.
